approved.title: war_hooks_and_gold
approved.caption: Acoustic pirate sea shanty with rough raspy goblin lead voice and guttural ragged crew responses, stomping tribal skin drums, catchy driving fiddle and low bowed strings. Aggressive mischievous goblin raiders, strong nautical folk melody, organic wooden percussion, instrumental breaks. No polished choir, no pop production, no electric guitars.
approved.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hooks in the rail, claws in the rope
Up from the black with a mouthful of smoke
Crack that hatch and break that chain
Fill our sacks and sail again
[Chorus]
Bite! Board! Break their line!
All that shiny loot is mine!
Claw! Cut! Haul below!
Black teeth grin where red tides flow!
[Instrumental]
[Chorus]
Bite! Board! Break their line!
All that shiny loot is mine!

approved.title: peace_six_clans_one_fire
approved.caption: Ancient tribal maritime folk instrumental, interlocking skin hand drums, low wooden reed pipes, bowed acoustic strings, resonant plucked lute, seed rattles. Goblin clans meeting around a great bonfire, solemn warm and proudly rustic, strong memorable modal melody with spacious acoustic call and response between reeds and strings. Natural live ensemble, no electronic sounds, no techno, no lofi, no synth ambience, no drum kit, no vocals.

approved.title: war_drums_beneath_the_volcano
approved.caption: Acoustic tribal naval battle instrumental, pounding interlocking hide drums, menacing low war horns, urgent scratchy fiddle ostinato, deep bowed strings, clacking wood and bone rattles. Goblin fleet launching beneath an erupting volcano, memorable aggressive nautical theme, tense opening builds to fierce rhythmic attack, quieter stalking bridge then powerful final charge. Organic live percussion and ancient instruments, no electronics, no synths, no drum machine, no modern rock band, no vocals.
